desc: Derive exact formulas for each (a,b) case and the aggregate sums needed: S1 = sum_v Lc[v]*Rc[v], S2 = sum_v Lc[v]*Rc[v]^2, S3 = sum_v Lc[v]^2*Rc[v], plus per-side pair sums P_L = sum C(Lc,2), P_R = sum C(Rc,2) over non-x values (maintain sums over all values and subtract x's contribution at query time); O(1) delta updates when a value moves from right map to left map.

Implement the sweep: initialize right frequency map with all elements, left empty; for each i, move nums[i] from right map, compute good(i) in O(1) using Lx, Rx and aggregate stats (subtracting x's own contributions), then add nums[i] to left map; all modulo 1e9+7.
Validate against the three examples and a brute-force checker on random small arrays (n <= 12), including duplicates-heavy and all-distinct cases; tie cases and l<2/r<2 edges verified.
Finalize solution in the starter code with comments explaining the case split; O(n) time / O(n) space confirmed.
